claims.assertion: Za'el says harmful surroundings can erode a person's frequency and draw them toward increasingly difficult experiences.
claims.speaker: Za'el
claims.qualifiers: He explicitly says this does not make the harmed person responsible.

claims.assertion: Za'el advises examining one's feelings, leaving harmful people when possible, and rebuilding inner strength when circumstances cannot change.
claims.speaker: Za'el
claims.qualifiers: He prioritizes personal wellbeing over forcing others to change.

claims.assertion: Arien frames some difficult circumstances as pre-incarnation learning challenges that can trigger emotional shadows.
claims.speaker: Arien de Erra
claims.qualifiers: She says changing one's response can reduce their impact even if others remain unchanged.

coverage_gaps: scenarios where external danger cannot be changed
